name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Release 1.36: Approved Lotus icon retained; experimental artwork excluded. Mobile update and offline flight verified.  Ear Yoga and Space Music College form one glyph-aligned lockup; S aligns to E and the subtitle stays above the g descender at every aspect ratio, with unified editor dragging. Approved main lettering, buttons and ship preserved. Opt-in desktop video recording with game audio only, local download, no microphone; mobile controls hidden. Only the Lotus ship; speed/altitude selectors removed, volume and EQ retained. Teacher-only translucent O2 fifth vial, separate H2O; 12 chord-relative tones, palette-normalized correct rewards (42 / valid tone count), scaled by route duration / -20 avoid, neutral uncertain cases and 180ms boundary grace. All 184 release routes audited with actual random side-lane medallions; imported m11/9/13/7#9/7#11/o families recognized without changing harmony. Unsupported neutral-only chords do not spend uncollectable O2. Smaller sparse side-lane bubbles unlock after two solved chords. O2 drains from the first chord at 0.45 per second, scaled by duration on long routes; positive O2 income scales too, unchanged collision and answer damage. Floating actual resource deltas. Click-through upper time/score frames, capped one-time bubble bonuses, completion time bonus and device-local PB. Test score, not online tournament validation. Original route notes, sounds, speed, cover and trial countdown preserved. Imported chord codes display as readable symbols. Mobile PWA release.
